sentences.text: I cannot confirm whether the 2% pre-payment charge is allowed because the sanction date is not in the evidence, and the applicable UCB rule applies only to loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026.

If the loan was sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on business-purpose loans to MSEs with sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh, and no undisclosed pre-payment charge may be charged.
The bank’s MSE sanction-letter template states pre-payment charges of 2% of the amount prepaid, but that bank policy does not answer the missing sanction-date condition.

missing.searched: Checked the sanction-letter evidence and the UCB pre-payment-charge rules for the sanction/renewal date; the evidence provided does not state when this loan was sanctioned or renewed.
